posts.subject: Admin apply For Bh server
posts.bodyHtml:
Hi everyone its my first time here so yes im aware its my first post and i havent been on teamspeak cause i have some problems login on it.
beside that let me start to introduce my self,
hi my name is Tiago im from Portugal and i have 19 years old i have been playing on your server quite a while and i saw this link saying i could apply so i decided to give it a shot i promise that if i get accepted i will be on more often and on teamspeak too (just need the ip).
besides that i think i would be a great admin cause even tho the server is empty i keep on playing on it please consider my application.
Im sorry if my speeling/grammar isnt the best because english isnt my first language but im really working on it so i can improve it.
Hope i get the answer soon and hope you having a great day 🙂

But I'm afraid to say that your activity level is not enough. As you said this is your first post and you also haven't been on the TS3 neither.
(The IP can be found at the top of the page, just click on "Teamspeak" or you can join manually via ts3.dream-community.de)


You should improve your activity level in these areas and then you can try it again.
Also you could introduce yourself in the forum, if you want to.
